description: This file defines a class 'Menu' within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Common' namespace. The class extends a base controller and primarily implements the 'index' method, which loads language files, models, retrieves categories and subcategories, and generates a structured menu for display in an OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: Controller class responsible for generating the main menu structure by retrieving categories and subcategories, and preparing data for rendering the menu view in the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that loads language files and models, builds a hierarchical menu structure with category information, product counts, and links, then returns the rendered view.
